description: Defines the HidlCamera3Device class for interfacing with HIDL HAL camera devices in Android, including mapping functions, callback implementations, and nested classes for HAL interface and request handling.

classes.name: HidlCamera3Device
classes.description: Main class for managing HIDL camera device interactions, including mapping functions, callbacks, and nested classes for HAL interface and request processing.

classes.name: HidlCamera3Device::HidlHalInterface
classes.description: Handles communication with the HAL interface, including constructing requests, configuring streams, and managing session states.

classes.name: HidlCamera3Device::HidlRequestThread
classes.description: Manages request threading for camera operations, including switching to offline mode.

classes.name: HidlCamera3Device::HidlCamera3DeviceInjectionMethods
classes.description: Handles injection-specific camera initialization and hal interface replacement.

methods.name: mapToPixelFormat
methods.description: Maps framework pixel format to HIDL pixel format.

methods.name: mapToHidlDataspace
methods.description: Maps framework dataspace to HIDL dataspace.

methods.name: mapToConsumerUsage
methods.description: Maps framework usage flags to HIDL buffer usage flags.

methods.name: mapToStreamRotation
methods.description: Maps rotation enum to HIDL stream rotation.

methods.name: mapToStreamConfigurationMode
methods.description: Converts operation mode to HIDL stream configuration mode.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the camera device with the provided manager and tags.

methods.name: processCaptureResult_3_4
methods.description: Processes capture results for API version 3.4.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Handles notification messages from the camera device.

methods.name: switchToOffline
methods.description: Switches the device to offline mode with specified streams.

methods.name: wrapAsHidlRequest
methods.description: Wraps camera request into HIDL format.

methods.name: switchToOffline
methods.description: Switches the HAL session to offline mode.

methods.name: injectionInitialize
methods.description: Initializes injection camera and generates HAL interface.

methods.name: createNewRequestThread
methods.description: Creates a new request thread for camera operations.

methods.name: createCamera3DeviceInjectionMethods
methods.description: Creates injection methods for the camera device.
